snippet.title: Little Prince Tyger | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Visceral and violent 2D action roguelike in a retro-aesthetic. Little Prince Tyger launches on Steam in 2027. Embark on a bloody conquest, overcoming strange, ancient beasts across more than 1000 hand-crafted, single-screen levels. 

Armed with a simple bow and arrow and tasked by the Queen with finding the lost Prince Galaad, traverse dangerous ancestral memories to unlock the skills and equipment required to survive out from under the mountain. Death is a certainty; but death is not the end. 

Each run combines fast-paced combat and a rich variety of perks that change the flow of the game. Perks enable your hunting proficiency and survivability to grow, adjusting stats (from bleed damage and movement, to draw speed and weight), to manipulating fluids, slowing down time, and gaining access to additional weaponry (such as javelins, boomerangs, throwing knives, traps, and more). 

💪 Master intense archery combat across 1000+ handcrafted one-screen levels. 

🤏 Overcome foes with surgical precision, environmental manipulation, and physics.

🔄️ Features an ever-changing roguelike loop full of growth opportunities. 

🏹 Take up the honourable mantle of hunter, and do not question it. 

Wishlist now to never miss an update!

https://bit.ly/LittlePrinceTyger

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Join the Alpha Playtest! 🎮

Get a head start on the hunt and join the Alpha Playtest from 8-18 Oct. Delve into the world of Little Prince Tyger, meet its colourful cast of characters, face incredibly able adversaries, and unearth lost secrets before anyone else. Learn more about the playtest, and what we hope to achieve with it, with our handy Alpha Playtest field guide.

https://steamcommunity.com/app/3710650/discussions/0/588439869536298281/
